environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; real TLS 1.3 sockets; three OS child peer-host processes with production engines, RawNodes and transport; explicit manual ticks; serial integration targets; debug assertions enabled; isolated checkout target; debuginfo=0
limitations: MR-04 transport qualification only. Child peer hosts use opaque fixture images rather than verified SQLite/LTX application. The embedded-node test qualifies infrastructure ownership, not Raft namespace/SDK command/query registration. Trusted route installation is not the durable birth/membership controller; MR-07/MR-11 remain required. S3 archival/restore, application/query behavior, production infrastructure, resident-memory and capacity qualification remain pending. No performance, end-to-end serving or deployment claim is made. The ignored child entry point is invoked by its parent test.

additional_check_results.frames_and_lifecycle: 8 passed: bounded prefix/protobuf preflight, request/response channel/target binding, strict identity/header checks and poisoned-registry join regression.
additional_check_results.core_regressions: 37 passed on final Rust source across native_raft_contract, native_raft_runtime, native_raft_storage, native_replication and native_storage. Two ignored child helpers are invoked by their parents.
additional_check_results.embedded_service: The embedded_node_joins_raft_service_with_retained_handles case passed on final Rust source, with the actual public Node bootstrap/shutdown and retained service handles.
additional_check_results.broader_regressions: All 88 native_node cases and 37 core cases passed in the broader run. That run began before the final transport-only enqueue refinement; the owning embedded service case, all core cases and all transport/frame cases were rerun on the final source. The native_node implementation was unchanged between those runs.
additional_check_results.concurrency: 32 concurrent senders preserve authenticated sequence order on a shared connection; bodies and permits drop before delivery completion wakes its observer.
additional_check_results.isolation: Held TLS bulk data exhausts the peer data budget while independent control traffic succeeds. Close refunds held bytes/items and releases task ownership.
additional_check_results.security: Forged response tags, wrong TLS hostname, plaintext, unknown groups, stale histories/processes and oversized headers/payloads are refused without durable progress. Responses bind TLS exporter, request tag and reversed exact route.
additional_check_results.process_faults: Three child peer hosts drive two groups with different leaders over shared physical-peer pools. A one-way partition cannot advance the isolated node; the majority progresses. Fresh authenticated frames exercise duplicate, reordered and delayed Raft messages before healing.
